name: stockwise-india
description: NSE-sourced data spine for Indian stock screening — replaces Screener.in scraping with NSE's own public corporate-filings API (financial results + shareholding pattern), same architecture as the stockwise-us SEC EDGAR spine.

scripts.pack:seed: COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --exclude .DS_Store -czf seed/market-data.tar.gz -C data market market-snapshot.json performance-snapshots.json shareholding
scripts.test: node server/auth-smoke-test.js && node server/http-smoke-test.js && node --no-warnings server/research-test.js && node --no-warnings server/performance-test.js && node server/upstream-test.js && node --no-warnings server/notice-tags-test.js && node server/unit-slips-test.js && node server/name-sectors-test.js && node --no-warnings server/data-pull-test.js && node --no-warnings server/export-excel-test.js
